reference_sql:
WITH months AS (
  -- one row per month of 2024 and 2025
  SELECT CAST(range AS DATE) AS month
  FROM range(DATE '2024-01-01', DATE '2026-01-01', INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
), created AS (
  -- one row per month with new accounts
  SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', created_at) AS DATE) AS month, COUNT(*) AS new_accounts
  FROM accounts
  WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY CAST(date_trunc('month', created_at) AS DATE)
)
SELECT m.month, COALESCE(c.new_accounts, 0) AS new_accounts
FROM months m
LEFT JOIN created c ON c.month = m.month

WITH months AS (
  -- one row per month of 2024 and 2025
  SELECT CAST(range AS DATE) AS month
  FROM range(DATE '2024-01-01', DATE '2026-01-01', INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
)
SELECT m.month,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM accounts a WHERE CAST(date_trunc('month', a.created_at) AS DATE) = m.month) AS new_accounts
FROM months m

WITH months AS (
  -- one row per month of 2024 and 2025
  SELECT CAST(generate_series AS DATE) AS month
  FROM generate_series(DATE '2024-01-01', DATE '2025-12-01', INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
)
SELECT m.month, COUNT(a.account_id) AS new_accounts
FROM months m
LEFT JOIN accounts a ON CAST(date_trunc('month', a.created_at) AS DATE) = m.month
GROUP BY m.month

solver.query:
WITH months AS (
  SELECT CAST(d AS DATE) AS month FROM generate_series(DATE '2024-01-01', DATE '2025-12-01', INTERVAL 1 MONTH) t(d)
), a AS (
  SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', created_at) AS DATE) AS month, COUNT(*) AS new_accounts
  FROM accounts
  WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 00:00:00' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT m.month, COALESCE(a.new_accounts, 0) AS new_accounts
FROM months m LEFT JOIN a ON a.month = m.month
